name: tracker_post_comment
description: Post one public triage comment to an issue; call last, after any required draft PR. Returns issue_id, comment_id and truncated=false, at most one receipt without echoing the body. Empty body is an error, never an empty success. This writes to the tracker; do not use it to draft or inspect text.

number.description: Positive issue number to target; use the assigned issue, not a guessed ID. Selects one issue per call.

body.description: Nonempty final comment, at most 4000 characters. First two lines are label: <label> and file: <repository path or none>. This text becomes visible; supply only the final triage, not reasoning notes.

examples.note: Typical format: post the final triage after evidence supports this file and the required draft PR has completed. This is an example, not a precomputed answer.

Hard case: if investigation concludes that no file needs changing, use the literal none and skip the PR. This illustrates a conditional outcome, not the answer to this issue; post only after investigation.
